nodes.title: SURVIVOR
nodes.description: The origin of every run.

nodes.title: AXE
nodes.description: Unlock the axe for efficient wood gathering.

nodes.title: PICKAXE
nodes.description: Unlock the pickaxe for efficient stone gathering.

nodes.title: EFFICIENT STRIKES
nodes.description: Tools deal 25% more damage to resources.

nodes.title: POWER SWING
nodes.description: Every third resource hit also strikes nearby deposits.

nodes.title: WIDE SWING
nodes.description: Power Swing reaches 50% farther.

nodes.title: HANDS-ON
nodes.description: Manual gathering is 45% stronger, but producers work 20% slower.

nodes.title: INDUSTRIALIST
nodes.description: Producers work 40% faster, but manual gathering is 20% weaker.

nodes.title: LUMBER MILL
nodes.description: Unlock the Lumber Mill for passive wood production during the day.

nodes.title: QUARRY
nodes.description: Unlock the Quarry for passive stone production during the day.

nodes.title: CRYSTAL MINE
nodes.description: Unlock the Crystal Mine for passive crystal production during the day.

nodes.title: NIGHT SHIFT
nodes.description: All production buildings operate at 50% speed during enemy waves.

nodes.title: COMBAT TRAINING
nodes.description: All player attacks deal 10% more damage.

nodes.title: CLUB
nodes.description: Unlock the club and its sweeping melee attacks.

nodes.title: RIFLE
nodes.description: Unlock accurate ranged combat.

nodes.title: ICE WAND
nodes.description: Unlock freezing projectiles and area control.

nodes.title: FIRE WAND
nodes.description: Unlock burning projectiles and damage over time.

nodes.title: BOMBS
nodes.description: Unlock bombs and receive two at the start of every night.

nodes.title: BOMB POUCH
nodes.description: Receive one additional bomb at the start of every night.

nodes.title: CONCUSSIVE SWINGS
nodes.description: Club attacks gain strong knockback.

nodes.title: BRUISER
nodes.description: Club damage and knockback increase greatly, but its area shrinks.

nodes.title: CROWD BREAKER
nodes.description: Club swings cover a much wider area, but deal less damage.

nodes.title: MARKSMAN
nodes.description: Rifle shots gain 70% damage and 35% range, but fire 30% slower.

nodes.title: ASSAULT DRILL
nodes.description: Rifle fires 50% faster with a larger magazine, but loses damage.

nodes.title: DEEP FREEZE
nodes.description: Ice covers a wider area and freezes longer, but deals less damage.

nodes.title: ICE LANCE
nodes.description: Ice projectiles deal heavy direct damage but have a smaller blast.

nodes.title: WILDFIRE
nodes.description: Fire spreads through a larger area and burns longer, with weaker impact.

nodes.title: INFERNO
nodes.description: Fire impact and burn damage increase, but the blast becomes smaller.

nodes.title: THERMAL SHOCK
nodes.description: Fire striking a frozen enemy consumes Freeze for a violent burst.

nodes.title: HAMMER
nodes.description: Unlock repair and active fortification.

nodes.title: REINFORCED FRAMES
nodes.description: All structures gain 20% maximum health.

nodes.title: FIELD REPAIRS
nodes.description: Surviving structures recover 18% health after every night.

nodes.title: DEFENSE ENGINEERING
nodes.description: Turrets, cannons and spike traps deal 12% more damage.

nodes.title: TURRET CALIBRATION
nodes.description: Turrets gain 20% range and damage.

nodes.title: RAPID BATTERY
nodes.description: Turrets fire 45% faster but lose 20% range.

nodes.title: LONG WATCH
nodes.description: Turrets gain 45% range and 30% damage, but fire slower.

nodes.title: ARTILLERY CORPS
nodes.description: Cannons gain 30% blast radius and damage.

nodes.title: TRAP ENGINEER
nodes.description: Traps gain radius, damage and faster recovery.

nodes.title: HIGH GROUND
nodes.description: Defenses built above terrain deal 35% more damage.

nodes.title: LIGHT FOOTWORK
nodes.description: Accelerate, stop and turn 55% faster.

nodes.title: SPRINTER
nodes.description: Move 10% faster at all times.

nodes.title: DASH
nodes.description: Burst in the movement direction.

nodes.title: IMPACT DASH
nodes.description: Starting a dash damages and knocks back nearby enemies.

nodes.title: LONG DASH
nodes.description: Dash travels farther and faster, but recovers 35% slower.

nodes.title: RAPID DASH
nodes.description: Dash recovers 45% faster, but travels a shorter distance.

nodes.title: NIGHT'S BOUNTY
nodes.description: Spawn an additional chest after every second survived night.

nodes.title: NIGHTLY DELIVERY
nodes.description: Night's Bounty now delivers a chest after every survived night.

nodes.title: SAFE DELIVERY
nodes.description: Reward chests arrive closer to the base.

nodes.title: KEYMASTER
nodes.description: All chests cost 20% fewer Coins to open.

nodes.title: EARLY PLANNING
nodes.description: Early wave starts grant Crystals, Coins and Insight; all early rewards increase 25%.

nodes.title: MERCENARY CONTRACT
nodes.description: Early starts grant many more Coins, but no bonus Insight.

nodes.title: SCHOLAR CONTRACT
nodes.description: Early starts grant much more Insight, but no bonus Coins.

nodes.title: EXPANDED STORAGE
nodes.description: Every storage building holds 40% more resources.

nodes.title: SCAVENGER
nodes.description: Destructible world props drop 50% more coins.

nodes.title: LONGER DAYS
nodes.description: Each daytime build phase lasts 15 seconds longer.
